adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`, `destroy` does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `host.destroy`. If no record exists for the given `params[:id]` (stale UI, double-submit, already-deleted), `host` will be `nil` and `nil.destroy` will raise a `NoMethodError`, returning a 500 instead of a graceful 404/200.
